verdict.rationale: Statsig's own docs state that feature flags and 2 million metered events are free, which shows that metered events drive cost and that a free tier exists. Nothing in the pack shows a published price list or paid tiers, so a product manager could not fully understand costs before committing. Missing for 10: published pricing page with paid-tier prices, explanation of whether seats/MAUs/requests factor into cost, overage rates, plan comparison, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing

citations.quote: You get feature flags and 2 million metered events for free.
